description: FORTVISION brings marketing activity into one workspace. Plan and manage campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn and DV360, track leads, deals and conversations, coordinate email, SMS, WhatsApp and LinkedIn outreach, run automations, and keep landing pages, social posts, coupons, meetings and projects organized in one place.

defaultPrompt: Which leads have had no follow-up in the last 7 days? Summarize them by source and owner.
How did my Meta and Google Ads campaigns perform this month? Show spend, leads and cost per lead.
Draft a follow-up email to the leads from my latest landing page and save it as a draft.
